read.sections.0.text.back: A tradition is a practice that is shared and repeated by people from time to time. It can be a feast, a song, a game, a skill or a celebration. Many traditions mark important times in the year. Nowruz is a new year celebration in spring. Millions of people celebrate Nowruz in many countries, from southeastern Europe to Central Asia. They tidy their homes, share special dishes and enjoy music and dancing. The community feast in the evidence is also a tradition. The senior citizen said this feast is important because people can meet, teach and welcome one another.
read.sections.0.text.source: A tradition is a practice that people share and repeat over time. It can be a meal, a song, a game, a skill or a celebration. Many traditions mark an important time of year. Nowruz is a spring new year. Millions of people celebrate it in many countries, from south-east Europe to Central Asia. People clean, share special meals and enjoy music and dance. The community meal in the evidence is a tradition too. The elder says it matters because people meet, teach and welcome each other.

read.sections.0.simpler.back: A tradition is a thing that people do again and again, over many years. It can be a feast, a song or a game. Many traditions mark a special time in the year. Nowruz is a new year in spring. People in many countries celebrate Nowruz. They tidy up, share food and dance. The feast in the evidence is also a tradition. According to the senior citizen, the feast helps people meet, teach and welcome other people.
read.sections.0.simpler.source: A tradition is a thing people do again and again, for many years. It can be a meal, a song or a game. Many traditions mark a special time of year. Nowruz is a new year in spring. People in many lands celebrate it. They clean, share food and dance. The meal in the evidence is a tradition too. The elder says it helps people meet, teach and welcome others.

read.sections.1.text.back: Many traditions help older people pass down knowledge to younger people. This is called inheritance (transmission). In Korea, families and neighbours make kimchi together in late autumn. This tradition is called kimjang. They share kimchi between homes and exchange ideas. In North Africa, people learn to make couscous by watching and copying other people. They eat it together at big family and community gatherings. In Tonga, large groups perform lakalaka. It is a dance with sung speeches about history and values. In the evidence, a young helper learns to make bread and wants to teach it next year.
read.sections.1.text.source: Many traditions help older people pass knowledge to younger people. This is called transmission. In Korea, families and neighbours make kimchi together in late autumn. This tradition is called kimjang. They share the kimchi between homes and swap ideas. In North Africa, people learn to make couscous by watching and copying others. They eat it together at big family and community events. In Tonga, large groups perform the lakalaka. It is a dance with sung speeches about history and values. In the evidence, a young helper learns to make the bread and wants to teach it next year.

read.sections.1.simpler.back: Traditions help the old teach the young. This is called inheritance (transmission). In Korea, people make kimchi from vegetables. They make it in large groups in autumn. Then they share the kimchi. In North Africa, people learn to cook couscous. It is a dish of grain that is tiny/small. They watch and copy other people. In Tonga, large groups sing and dance lakalaka. Its songs tell about the past. In the evidence, a young helper learns to make bread.
read.sections.1.simpler.source: Traditions help older people teach younger people. This is called transmission. In Korea, people make kimchi from vegetables. They make it in a big group in autumn. Then they share it. In North Africa, people learn to cook couscous. It is a dish of tiny grains. They watch others and copy them. In Tonga, big groups sing and dance the lakalaka. The songs tell about the past. In the evidence, a young helper learns to make bread.

read.sections.2.heading.back: Traditions can change and still matter
read.sections.2.heading.source: Traditions can change and still matter

read.sections.2.text.note: Back-translation check: Replaced the calque 'Ia membantu apabila...' with 'Ada baiknya jika...'. Check this reads naturally.
read.sections.2.text.back: Traditions are not frozen in the past. People adapt traditions to new times. This year, the feast added a vegetarian dish and started earlier, so that more people could take part. The new neighbour said the earlier time meant he/she could come for the first time. Changes like this can help a tradition keep its purpose: meeting, teaching and welcoming. It helps when the group discusses what to keep and what to change. Not everyone in a community follows the same traditions or gives them the same meaning. No tradition is better than other traditions.
read.sections.2.text.source: Traditions are not frozen in the past. People adapt them to fit new times. This year, the meal adds vegetarian dishes and starts earlier, so more people can take part. The new neighbour says the earlier time means they can come for the first time. A change like this can help a tradition keep its purpose: to meet, teach and welcome. It helps when the group talks about what to keep and what to change. Not everyone in a community follows the same traditions or gives them the same meaning. No tradition is better than another.

read.sections.2.simpler.back: Traditions do not stay the same forever. People adapt traditions to new times. This year, the feast has food without meat. It also starts earlier. Now a new neighbour can come. So the feast stays with its purpose. It still helps people meet and welcome other people. The group can discuss what to keep. Not everyone in one group does the same things. No tradition is better than other traditions.

write.example.back: The purpose of the feast is to meet, teach and welcome people. The senior citizen said this is why the event is important. One change is that the feast now starts earlier. This can help because a new neighbour can come for the first time. The vegetarian dish may also allow more people to eat together. So the change can help the feast stay with its purpose. The organisers should also ask people which part matters most to them.

watch.summary.back: This video was made at the Smithsonian Folklife Festival in Washington, D.C., in the United States. This festival invites people from many communities. They share their music, dance, handicrafts and food. In this video, people at the festival talk about why sharing culture is important. Sharing culture helps people learn about one another. It helps them see the world in new ways. It can help people stay strong in hard times and feel happy in good times. Each person who speaks gives their own view. Not one person speaks on behalf of a whole culture. When you share with respect, you listen to the people who practise a tradition. You also give appreciation/credit to them.
watch.summary.source: This video was made at the Smithsonian Folklife Festival in Washington, D.C., in the United States. The festival invites people from many communities. They share their music, dance, crafts and food. In the video, people at the festival talk about why sharing culture matters. Sharing culture helps people learn about each other. It helps them see the world in new ways. It can help people stay strong in hard times and feel joy in good times. Each speaker gives their own view. No one person speaks for a whole culture. When you share with respect, you listen to the people who practise a tradition. You also give them credit.
